title: Offer actionable project recovery
description: Detect a recoverable project draft or interrupted durable-state transition and present truthful recovery choices instead of silently discarding or overwriting state.
acceptanceCriteria: Recoverable state is detected from an explicit durable revision or recovery marker
The user sees which project can be recovered and why recovery is offered
A recovery action restores the last known recoverable project state
A discard action requires explicit confirmation and removes only the recoverable marker
Malformed or unreadable recovery data leaves the last-known-good project intact and shows an actionable explanation

steps.details: Add a versioned `DraftStatus` or equivalent durable marker that distinguishes clean state from a recoverable revision without embedding editor-specific content.
Read recovery metadata after repository initialization and expose a typed clean, recoverable, or unreadable result to the shell.
Render a named recovery status with native recover and discard controls, a confirmation before discard, and focus placement on the recovery heading or first action.
Make recovery/discard updates atomic and ensure parsing or storage failure cannot replace the durable project with an empty or partially decoded value.
Seed a recoverable marker, restart the browser context, exercise recover and discard paths, and assert visible outcomes and durable records.

technicalNotes: Recovery is distinct from cloud backup or cross-device sync.
Never silently prefer malformed recovery data over a valid durable record.
